quarterly_data.quarter: Doosan Enerbility press release: Doosan Enerbility Wins Contract to Build Misfah Combined (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Nebras Power consortium: the Misfah combined cycle gas power plant in Oman is 1,700MW, located about 20km west of central Muscat; Doosan Enerbility formed an EPC consortium with SEPCO-3 and will directly supply the steam turbines and generators; total contract approximately KRW 930 billion, completion targeted for April 2029. The client is a developer consortium of Qatar's Nebras Power, the UAE's EUDC (an Etihad Water and Electricity subsidiary) and Oman's Bahwan Infrastructure Services. Plant EPC Business Group CEO Hyeonho Lee attributes the award to project execution in Saudi Arabia and Qatar; the company lists recent combined-cycle wins incl. the Qatar Peaking Unit, Saudi Rumah 1, Nairyah 1 and PP12, Vietnam's O Mon 4 (approximately KRW 900 billion) and Duqm, Oman.
quarterly_data.figure: 1,700MW plant; approximately KRW 930 billion; completion April 2029
